summary: Tested new AI Assistant (GPT-5.4) + first-launch onboarding tutorial end-to-end. Backend pytest 3/3 passing (test_assistant_chat.py): POST /api/assistant/chat returns 401 without auth; returns non-empty English reply for 'How do I export a PDF?'; returns Italian reply that includes project context (title/scene count of c73286507b42) when project_id + language:'it' provided. Frontend (mobile 390x844): fresh login to sb_1785767871@studio.com correctly redirects to /onboarding (client gate via ff_onboarding_done_v1 in AsyncStorage). Slide 1 shows 'Welcome to FrameFlow'; onboarding-next advances slides; dots update; onboarding-skip finishes and navigates to /dashboard. On re-navigation the gate does NOT re-trigger. AssistantFab (testID='assistant-fab') is present on /dashboard, /settings and /project/c73286507b42. Tapping it opens a bottom-sheet with assistant-input, assistant-send, and suggestion chips assistant-sugg-0..N. Sending 'How do I export a PDF?' produced a real GPT-5.4 assistant reply mentioning the Exports tab and PDF option (verified visually + in DOM). Settings 'Account' tab exposes assistant-link that navigates to /assistant (dedicated screen with assistant-input + assistant-back), and tutorial-link that navigates to /onboarding?replay=1 and returns to /settings on Skip (replay mode router.back(), NOT to dashboard). Regressions confirmed: theme-dark, lang-it, imgmodel-gemini all still render in settings; project storyboard/overview loads normally.
action_items: No fixes required. Both features are functioning as spec'd.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py assistant_chat correctly: gates on auth via Depends(get_current_user), returns 502 on LLM failure (not 500), enforces IT/EN via system-prompt suffix, injects project context ONLY when the requesting user owns the project (find_one is scoped to user_id), and trims history to last 10 messages to keep prompt size bounded.
AssistantFab: single global instance mounted in (tabs)/_layout.tsx and per-project instance in project/[id].tsx — no double-mount when the tabs render.

Onboarding gate is client-side (AsyncStorage flag ONBOARDING_KEY='ff_onboarding_done_v1') — correct for cost-free first-launch UX. Replay mode uses router.back() instead of router.replace('/dashboard'), preserving Settings context.
AssistantChat sends messages array + project_id + language via api.assistantChat and gracefully falls back to t('error') on catch — good UX.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all onboarding, FAB, chat, links, project, regression flows verified)

seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded account sb_1785767871@studio.com and project c73286507b42. Consumed 2 real LLM calls total (1 backend English + 1 backend Italian+context) plus 1 UI-driven English call — within the 'keep to 1-2' budget suggested by main agent.
